disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV criteria for MDD; combined first-episode MDD (n=381) and recurrent MDD (n=118) from REST-meta-MDD consortium. Normative modeling (hierarchical Bayesian regression) applied to assess within-group heterogeneity in ACC cortical thickness.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "499 patients with MDD (381 first-episode MDD, 118 recurrent MDD) ... All patients met the DSM-IV criteria for MDD"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Structural brain imaging data from the REST-MetaMDD Consortium, consisting of 25 research groups in 17 hospitals in China; 499 MDD patients selected from 9 study sites after quality exclusions.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Structural brain imaging data were used from the REST-MetaMDD Consortium (35), which consists of 25 research groups in 17 hospitals in China."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from FE MDD (n=381, mean=34.72, SD=12.26) and Recurrent MDD (n=118, mean=39.98, SD=13.26). Age range for MDD patients not separately reported; combined sample (patients + HCs, n=1023) range was 12–77 years.
age.supporting_text: "FE MDD Total n=381, Age, Years, Mean (SD): 34.72 (12.26); Recurrent MDD Total n=118, Age, Years, Mean (SD): 39.98 (13.26)"

sex.detail: Summed from FE MDD (female=259, male=122) and Recurrent MDD (female=77, male=41). Total MDD n=499.
sex.supporting_text: "FE MDD Female 259 ... Male 122; Recurrent MDD Female 77 ... Male 41"
